scope: Single-machine resource policy, explicit maintenance, external index relocation, upgrade rollback and Windows uninstall
test_command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_runtime_policy.py tests/test_maintenance.py tests/test_upgrade_lifecycle.py tests/test_resources.py tests/test_packaging.py -q
verified_scenarios: Resource presets preserve search scope, exclusions, database configuration and disk quota
Timed pause survives service restart and expires after offline time
Continuous foreground result polling allows a background tick at least every three seconds when other policy constraints allow it
CPU hysteresis, battery retreat, AC-only and idle-only recovery; unavailable idle detection explicitly reported
Concurrent index leases and a different instance owner are rejected
Index relocation keeps stable data/config/model paths and retains the old index
Partial copy failure restores exact configuration and can retry the same owned destination
Interrupted copy and crash after verified configuration switch recover from durable transaction records
Active daemon blocks relocation, restore and backup cleanup
Modified old-index backup refuses cleanup; unrelated source content remains intact
Configuration export removes credentials and instance identity; restore validates missing local paths and explicit mappings
Client registration is idempotent and reports shared-instance impact
Native upgrade failed activation restores external SQLite schema, exact previous configuration and old runtime
Upgrade snapshot holds model admission/worker/service and index locks
Completed upgrade backup cleanup preserves active external index and runtime

windows_uninstall_smoke.method: Real daemon and actual PowerShell uninstall script; temporary installed CLI wrapper dispatches current development Python modules

not_claimed: Frozen v0.4 release end-to-end install/upgrade/uninstall validation is a separate release acceptance run
Linux systemd and uninstall behavior has not been validated on a real Linux host in this report
Physical 8GB/16GB memory and battery hardware behavior has not been measured
Hundreds-of-gigabytes production corpus performance and long-running soak stability are not measured by these synthetic functional tests
Resource limits are scheduling/enforcement settings, not measured consumption or latency guarantees

windows_runtime_swap_regression.observed_in: v0.4 candidate-2 native external-index reinstall acceptance
windows_runtime_swap_regression.failure_before_fix: WinError 5 while renaming the stopped native runtime directory
windows_runtime_swap_regression.cause_boundary: Service state and instance locks can disappear before Windows releases runtime file mappings; the exact holder was not captured in the candidate failure.
windows_runtime_swap_regression.fix: Retry only Windows access/sharing/lock errors (5,32,33) for at most five seconds during runtime swap and rollback while maintenance locks remain held.
verified: A real Windows open file prevents directory rename with the same error class; closing the handle permits bounded retry success.
All four swap and rollback directory moves tolerate one transient sharing failure and restore the old runtime.
A persistent sharing failure stops at the deadline and retains the unchanged old executable, configuration and pre-migration snapshot.
Ordinary non-Windows permission failures are raised immediately.
